svg.title: rEach and Teach: what rEach keeps on the computer
svg.desc: The folders rEach keeps on the student's computer: the reach-work folder with the student's work, rEach's own closed home and the memory, a second copy of checkpoints in the account's application data, the memory library's shared state, the Downloads folder, the background jobs and the commands that show and erase each copy.
svg.text: What rEach keeps on the computer
Every folder rEach writes, who it belongs to and how to erase it. Uninstalling never touches the work.
assignment work, one folder per slice
the memory's files, marked with the student's ID
rEach itself, replaced by each update
sign-in, sync and update progress, and more
a save of the slice on every write
the runtime kit: Ruby and Chrome for Testing
A second copy of every checkpoint, filed under a code, and seal.json: the
fingerprint's secret and this computer's enrollments. Both stay when
rplugin state, shared by the account
What rEach learned and its copy of what was typed, not split by student:
a shared computer should give each student their own account.
A ZIP of each submitted assignment with its receipts, a conversation ZIP
when the student asks, and a setup report after three failed setups.
"Anything new?": every few minutes in a session, about every 10 minutes otherwise
Assignment conversations: sent about every ten minutes
Updates: checked hourly, installed at the next session start
Runtime kit: installed in the background when missing
Conversations are deleted 180 days after the course ends, unsent ones after 30. Uninstall keeps the student's work and memory unless asked.
